title: Editorial policy
description: Who prepares {{appName}} guides, which sources they rely on and how they are kept up to date.

sections.title: Responsibility
paragraphs: {{appName}} guides are published on behalf of the brand's publisher under the editorial responsibility of the founder introduced on this page. The author name under each article links to this profile.

sections.title: Sources and method
paragraphs: Age, duration and topic recommendations are based on preschool classroom practice, {{appName}} teacher plans and official frameworks such as the Turkish Ministry of National Education preschool programme and the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages.
Linking to a source does not mean that institution endorses the {{appName}} approach.

sections.title: AI assistance
paragraphs: Some drafts may use AI tools for structure, plain-language editing and translation. Before publication every text is checked by a human editor for accuracy, age-appropriateness and classroom feasibility.

sections.title: Updates and corrections
paragraphs: Articles are updated when the content changes meaningfully, and the update date is shown under the article. You can report errors through the channels on the contact page; verified corrections are applied to the article.

sections.title: Limits
paragraphs: Guides are for general information. Recommendations such as lesson length or vocabulary size vary with class level, group size and each child's development. Unmeasured learning outcomes or success rates are never stated.
